text:
Sophie: quick heads-up — ran large sweep on A10/T4/L4/A100/H100 for continuous-batching knobs. seeing an H100 regression when max_tokens_per_batch > 768k and KV hit rate drops below ~65%. attaching profiler snippet and notes.

Jamal: can you paste the profiler snippet so we can see kernel selection shifts? :eyes:

Sophie: pasted below. main takeaway: when KV miss spikes we switch from fused-kv-path to fallback kernels, softmax and attention kernels flip to v2 series and per-token kernel time jumps ~22%. also packing ratio goes down (more small slices).

```
# profiler excerpt (summary)
gpu: H100
workload: chat-like, seq avg 512
kv_hit: 58% -> drop
kernel_profile:
  fused_attention_v1: 42% -> 18%
  fused_attention_v2: 10% -> 40%  # fallback heavier perf
  softmax_v2: 8% -> 25%
pack_ratio: 0.71 -> 0.44
avg_slice_tokens: 112 -> 46
latency_per_token: 0.46ms -> 0.56ms
```

Maria: interesting — does this only show up on H100? what about A100 and L4?

Sophie: A100 stable up to ~1.1M tokens/batch; beyond that we start seeing memory thrash but kernel selection stays on fused path most of the time. L4/T4/A10 hit packing limits earlier — they never get to the large-token regimes where kernel fallbacks dominate, but they suffer from fragmentation with larger max_batch_tokens.

Tyler: summary for action items?

Jamal: propose heuristic delta:
- reduce max_tokens_per_batch caps for H100 by 20% when KV_hit < 70%
- introduce sigmoid-based slice growth so small requests still pack aggressively but we cap large-slice formation rate when pack_ratio < 0.5
- prefer small-slice-first queue policy on T4/A10 to avoid fragmenting KV cache

Alex: can you show pseudocode for the sigmoid gating? want to review before we change runtime defaults.

Sophie: sure, rough proto:

```
# sigmoid gating for slice growth
# inputs: pack_ratio (0..1), avg_slice_tokens
alpha = 12.0
beta = 0.5
g = 1.0 / (1 + exp(-alpha * (pack_ratio - beta)))
# growth factor clamps between 0.5..1.25
growth = 0.5 + 0.75 * g
new_slice_target = clamp(avg_slice_tokens * growth, min=32, max=4096)
```

Sophie: idea is when pack_ratio is low (lots of small slices / fragmentation) the sigmoid output -> small growth so we avoid creating few huge slices that force kernel fallback. when pack_ratio healthy, allow more aggressive slice growth.

Maria: sounds sensible. how do we measure KV fragmentation? we have metric kv_frag_percent that measures unused KV allocation per slot. use that alongside pack_ratio for circuit breaker.

Jamal: rollout plan suggestion:
- perf A/B on canary pool: deploy heuristic to 10% H100 machines + 10% A100 for contrast
- run 6 2-hour synthetic runs with low/high KV-hit workloads
- collect kernel selection traces, pack_ratio, latencies, and per-token cost

Alex: add these exact test tags to perf-bot run please.

perf-bot: scheduled perf job 3975312710 for tags: ["sigmoid-slice-test", "kv-frag-low", "kv-frag-high", "gpu-family: H100,A100"] :rocket:

Tyler: one more ask — can we add a safety softcap (hard decrement) on H100 at 900k tokens-per-batch so we never hit OOM/GC path even if heuristic misses? keep alert if we hit softcap in canary.

Sophie: yes will add softcap 900000 tokens for H100 and 1.2M for A100 in the config. will open PR with config and perf-run dashboards linked.

Alex: thanks — if canary looks good we roll to 50% and monitor kernel-switch rates. :thumbsup:

Jamal: also capture a counter for "kernel_fallback_rate" per minute so we can alert on regressions automatically.

Sophie: adding that to perf PR. will post dashboard links once the job finishes. :eyes:

perf-bot: perf job 3975312710 started. logs will appear in #eng-runtime/perf-runs.

Alex: ping me when first run completes.

Maria: tl;dr: keep A100 high ceiling, tighten H100 ceilings on KV-miss, add sigmoid slice growth, small-slice-first queue for T4/A10, and a softcap safety net.

Tyler: +1

Sophie: filing follow-ups: PR(#) config, PR(#) runtime-gating, dashboard update. will link when ready. :white_check_mark:
